title: Ghostly/ Hockey Charcuterie Board
instructions:
The anchor for this unearthly tray of goodies is a shaped brie ghost face with blackberry jam for the cut-out eyes, nose and mouth. Keep it spooky with dark fruits and COLUMBUS® Prosciutto Paninos invoking fingers. Try slicing and folding your favorite COLUMBUS® Craft Meats: chunks, thin folds and grabbable rounds of Salami and Sopressata make for a more fascinating platter. A wedge of hard cheese with purple rind can be carved into a coffin shape to add sinister flare. Scattered sliced figs with juicy, blood red centers give pops of color. Toss in the boundless variety of crackers now available and you have a Halloween charcuterie board worthy of murderous fun. Place a “bloodied” (raspberry jam covered) knife on the table and then answer the phone if you dare.
Fans of the creepy 80s hockey mask hijinks will swoon at the sight of the vintage mask that takes front and center stage on this tray. The varieties of COLUMBUS® salumi in a dizzying array of rolls, folds and thick slices deserve equal billing. Dark, dried plums create the blank stare along with raisins and salami cut-outs decorating the mask. Blueberry-studded cheddar with a mini cleaver provide further menace to this tray. To lighten the eerie mood, toss in ghostly pretzels, spiderweb cookies and berries. Reminiscent of “fun” summer camp, place the canoe paddle and t-shirt as backdrop to this scene. Consider introducing a smoke machine or dry ice and your guests will not soon forget this Halloween party centerpiece.
